tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgol ngan 'joms pa lung rigs nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ya mān+ta kā ya/ stang zil brtsegs pa 'tsher byed ni// rab brjid brang skyes kyis 'khyud pa'i// lnga pa'i bdag po mthar byed khyod// dus kun bdag gi dpal du shar// rgyud kyi dgongs pa ches brling ba'i// mkhas pa'i spyod yul nyid gyur kyang*// blun po gang zhig 'khrul ba'i blos// legs par 'dren pa 'ga' med dam// nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam// rtog ge'i gzhal bya yin brlams nas// rkang drug mchu yi rol rtsed kyis// gdengs can mthar byed sha thang ngo*// rgyud lung man ngag chu gter cher// blo gros ri dbang gis bsrubs pa'i/ */legs bshad nyi ma'i do shal 'dis// rmongs mun rming med ma byas sam// sngon byon mkhas mang tsha zer can// zhi ba nub rir gzhol ba'i dus// ltas ngan 'dab chags la la dag /log rtog smre sngags 'o dod 'bod// 'on kyang 'gro sogs bsod nams mthus// rgol ngan sngo bsang ma gzhom zhing*// legs pa'i snang ba kun spel ba'i// 'khrul 'joms me sbyin dbang po shar// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed rigs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi khro chu dug gdong nag po'i rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas par sngon byon mkhas pa'i dbang po gsang ba rig pa 'dzin pa mang dag gis nyan bshad kyis gtan la phab cing*/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i bshad pa'i srol dbang lung lag len brgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i bar du zam ma chad cing*/ mi bar khyis ma chod pa kho nar gyur pas yin min gyis stangs gcod dang gya tshom brtag dpyad kyi gnas su nam yang ma gyur mod/ 'on kyang snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gang zag las ngan gyi rnam par smin pa la longs spyod cing dug lnga me ltar 'bar bas nges pa'i lung rnams log par bkral zhing*/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol la ma sbyangs shing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnas la blo rmongs pa/

bsnyen sgrub chu tshod gcig gi yun tsam yang ma sbyangs shing dam tshig la spang blang gang yang mi byed pa'i skye bo phal mo ches ngag 'khyal smra ba'i dus 'dir/ rgyud don gyi gnas la 'khrul ba las kyang ches 'khrul ba'i rang bzo ham stobs kyi spyi brtol gyi dris lan rgyud don gsal bar byed pa zhes sman gdong rgyud gsum gyi don rnam par 'khyams shing legs bshad kyi cha tsam yang med pa'i bab col gyi dpe 'khyar zhig phyogs 'dir lhags so// tshul de lta bu brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka grong pa'i byis pa btsas ma thag pa'i ngag ltar gyur pas gang bder bzhag kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang rgol ngan tshul dang mi mthun pa dag gnas lnga smra ba rnams kyis rig lam du ma'i sgo nas tshar gcod pa'i 'os su gyur pa dag la 'di skad smra'o// tshul de lta bu dgag pa la gnyis/ rjod byed la dgag pa/ brjod bya la dgag pa'o// dang po la gsum ming tshig yi ge'o// dang po la brjod pa'i yul du gyur cing lung du ston pa'i ngag thams cad brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs la ltos dgos la/ de'ang lang gshegs las/ ming du gdags pa ma mdzad na// 'jig rten gsum po 'di dag ni// smag rum mun pa nyid yin phyir// mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad// ces gsungs pas/ dris lan 'di la brjod gzhir gyur pa'i rang bzhin dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum las/ tshogs pa dang so sor gyur pa'i ming gi gnas rnams la rnam par 'khyams pa'i grong tshig la zhen pa'i gnas brjod las 'das pa dag mchis| dper na mig sman zhes pa ni/ skabs thob kyi dbang gis kha dog so sor 'chad pa la/ kho'i zhe 'dod nag po kho nar blo rtse gtad pa dang*/ gzhan yang mchod brjod de lhug par bshad la/ kha dog nag po brtsegs pa'i ri rab kyi bskal pa'i me dpung gi gos gyon nang 'jam dpal gshin rje dang mtshungs so zhes bshad mod/ 'jam dpal gshin rje ni chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/

mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan thugs rje'i mnga' bdag yon tan bgrang las 'das pa'i bdag nyid/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid yin pa la/ ri nag po me'i gos gyon pa dang mtshungs sbyor yang snyan ngag gi skyon kho nar 'gyur la/ yang khyod kyi zhe 'dod snyan ngag mkhan la bkag pa med par sems na'ang*/ ji skad du/ 'dra ba'i phyir na dngos ma yin// mi 'dra ba la dpe ma grub// ces bshad pas so// des na de 'dra ba'i ming la rmongs pas gzhan pa'i legs bshad ci'i phyir 'byung*/ gnyis pa ni/ tshig ces bya ba/ dbye ba'i mthar rkyen sbyor ba dang ming mthar rkyen sbyar ba la 'byung ste/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel chen las/ tshig gang zhe na/ ting nga'i mtha' can dang su sa'i mtha' can no// zhes te sogs kyi rkyen brgya dang brgyad cur sbyar ba'am/ yang na rtags kyi don gyi tshig la rnam dbye dang po'i bod pa la 'ong ngo/ lhag ma rnams/ las/ byed pa/ yang dag pa rab tu sbyin pa/ nges par kun sbyin pa bdag po la sogs pa gzhi rnams la'o// zhes bshad pa las/ dri lan 'di la mchan bu btags pa yod pa ltar/ rnam dbye dgos par chad pa dang*/ mi dgos par lhag pa sogs ches nongs so/ gsum pa ni/ sum cu pa las/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*| |rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu// ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa lta zhog |tha na grong tshig tsam yang yi ge'i sbyor ba la ma brten par mi 'byung na/ dris lan 'dir/ rkyang pa/ phul byed/ mgo can/ mtha' can/ tshig phrad la sogs pa skabs don so sor dgos gal che ba rnams ni/ sum rtags smra sgo mtshon cha/ yi ge'i mdo/ rtags kyi bstan bcos sogs legs bshad kun dang rgyab phyogs pa nyi ma dang mun pa ltar ram/ sbrul dang gla rtsi'i dri ltar gyur pa'ang so so'i mchan bus gsal bar phye ba las rtogs pas g.yar tsha bar ma gyur tam/

gnyis pa brjod bya dgag pa la'ang gsum/ lung dang*/ rig pa/ gtan tshig gis dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ khyod kyi zhe 'dod 'khrul ba'i tshig gis drangs pa'i ngag 'khyal/ rtsa rgyud zla gsang*/ bsdus rgyud sman gdong*/ bshad rgyud kha thun zhes gya tshom byas par brtag na/ khro chu'i rtsa rgyud zla gsang*/ bshad rgyud kha thun zhes pa/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dpal gshin rje shākya seng ge sogs nas da lta'i bar gyi brgyud pa 'di la ma grags shing*/ de las gzhan pa'i lugs ni khyad chos yin srid do// de'ang bdag bskyed la sman gdong rtsa rgyud le'u so lnga pa'i le'u bcu par/ bdag nyid las kyi gshin rje sku mdog dmar nag me ltar 'bar ba/ zhes pa nas/ khog par srid pa gsum po yod par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag bskyed gtso bor bstan pa tsam las/ rtsa rgyud du 'khor gyi gshin rje sde drug gi zhal phyag dngos bstan ma bshad la/ sman gdong man ngag gyi rgyud le'u dgu pa'i le'u lnga par/ bdag nyid las kyi gshin rje'i gshed// 'jigs rngam khro bar rab bsgoms shing*// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang*// gnyis med sprul pa sde drug bshad// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dgra sta dang*// tsit+ta thogs pa'i rnam pa can// sku smad phur bu rdo rje'i 'dab// 'bar bcas sku ni gsal bar bsgom// mdun du'ang de 'dra gsal bskyed la// zhes bshad pa nas/ bdag mdun gnyis kar sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis su bskyed pa ches gsal bar gsungs shing*/ sman gdong phyi ma'i rgyud le'u nyer gcig pa'i le'u lnga pa dang bcu gsum par/ gtso bo'i zhal gsum yum dang sbyor zhing*/ sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la ya ma rā dza chu srin gyi zhal can dang*/ spyi gshed dug gsum khros pa zhal gsum phyag drug par bshad pas/ de ltar sman gdong rgyud gsum las de ltar bshad par/ rgol ba po rnams ni ches cher nongs so// kha cig ni sman gdong rtsa rgyud tsam las man ngag gi rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis ma mthong bar zad la/

dngos bstan rgyud gsum nas tshul 'di ltar gsal bar bshad pa dor nas/ man ngag dang yig chung dang yang yig dang shog dril sogs kha cig la bshad do// zhes pa ni/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos/ bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyams myong log rtog tu gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rig pas dgag pa la'ang*/ khyod kyi zhe 'dod sde drug gtso bo'i sprul pa yin pas zhal gsum phyag drug tu 'dod/ ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'gyed/ ces pas kyang sde drug gtso bo dang 'dra bar 'dod pa sogs mang du snang mod/ tshul de ni spyir btang gtso bo'i sprul pa yin no cog gtso bo dang 'dra dgos par rgyud gang gi dgongs par yang mi 'gro ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ bde dgyes/ 'jigs gsang sogs kyi 'khor rnams gtso bo'i sprul par bshad kyang zhal phyag mi 'dra ba ches mang ba dang*/ dgyes rdor lha mo brgyad sogs gtso bo yab yum gyi mngal 'byin byas pa'i 'khor rnams dang*/ yang gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'khor rnams zhal phyag mi 'dra ba kho na mang zhing*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bya rog gdong gsum yang gtso bo dang zhal phyag 'dra min dang*/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi sku gsung thugs sprul gsum yang gtso bo dang zhal phyag mi 'dra ba sogs tshul 'di lta bu grangs mang du gsungs shing gtso bo'i sprul pa thams cad gtso bo dang zhal phyag 'dra dgos pa khas len ches pa dang*/ bye brag tu khro chu mdun bskyed kyi zhal gdams su/ sde drug zhal gsum phyag drug tu byas pa de las byang la 'dod do zhe na/ der me'i 'khor lo rtsibs gsum la dug gsum gshin rje dang*/ gzhan yang a ba glang mgo dang*/ gshin rje chos rgyal sogs mang du gsungs pa'i tshul 'di ni las sbyor gyi mngon rtogs kho na las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi mngon rtogs ma yin la/ yang las sbyor gyi mngon rtogs bsnyen sgrub la 'gebs pa mi 'thad pa ci yin zhe na/

spyir btang du ma bshad pa rnams rigs bsgres te bsgom zhing skabs don so sor bshad pa rnams so sor ma 'dres par bya ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i gnad dam pa yin la/ bye brag tu gshin rje khro chu'i bsnyen sgrub la sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang*/ las sbyor la sde drug zhal gsum phyag drug dang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gang rung dang*/ zlog pa la kha thun dang 'char ka sogs lus dkyil du bsgom pa dang*/ skabs don gyi dmigs bsal ches mang zhing*/ de bzhin tu tshe bdag gi sprul pa gsum yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor so sor bsgom tshul mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsnyen pa'i dus zhal gsum 'khor zhal dang*/ sgrub pa la brtsegs zhal gdong gas ma dang*| las sbyor la mgon po gdong brnyan can sogs shin tu mang bar gsungs pa tshul de 'dra ba mtha' yas par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang khro chu'i sman gdong rgyud gsum gsal bar byed pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bshad pa'i yig char yang*/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor thams cad la sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis bsgom par bshad pa'i tshul la sogs pa mtha' yas par gsungs pa rnams blo ldan lung rigs mthong ba rnams kyis ni sun 'byin par ci zhig nus/ thos chung rmig rjes rgya mtshor rlom zhing log rtog gi bskyar 'byin skyo sngog lnga brgya byed pa rnams la ni ci byar yod/ gsum pa gtan tshig dgag pa ni/ spyir btang du drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyis bshad pa'i mtha' drug tshul bzhi ldan pa'i sman gdong rgyud gsum gyi lung gsal por drangs pa gong du bshad ma thag pa de tsam gyis kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang phyi rabs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyis rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa dbang rtul rnams kyis go bde ba'i phyir khrigs chags su mdzad pa rnams ni gzhir bzhag nas bshad pa'ang*/ thog mar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i khro chu'i las byang mu stegs srog gi spu grir bdag bskyed tshe bdag dang*/

mdun bskyed khro chu gtso 'khor bsgom na 'grub thag shin tu nye bar bshad nas/ de dag gi mdun bskyed kyi skabs su/ mdun du sku'i sprul pa 'chi bdag nag po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ g.yas dgra sta dang g.yon tsit+ta bsnams pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ khyod rang gi dris lan du| rgyal ba'i dbang po rin chen phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i las byang dang*/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog gi las byang ljags bsgrigs gnyis khungs su drangs 'dug pas/ de la rje rat+nas mdzad pa'i khro chu'i las byang gdug pa tshar gcod dang*/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog gis mdzad pa'i las byang gdug pa tshar gcod gnyis tshogs las man chad ma gtogs de yan tshig don phal cher 'dra bar/ bdag bskyed kyi sde drug gi skabs/ kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam// zhes bshad cing*/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs/ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal// zhes pa nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ bdag nyid skad cig rdzus skyes rdo rje'i sku// zhes pa'i mal du/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po ni// zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs mdun bskyed du'ang sde drug zhal gsum phyag drug tu bsgyur dgos pa'i tshig zur tsam yang med pa la de lta bu'i bsnyon tol byed pa ni ci zhig sems/ gzhan yang sman gdong rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi par gtor ma'i bskyed lugs bshad pa'i skabs su/ gtor ma 'jam dpal gshin rjer bsam// rtsa rnams khro chung sprul par bsam// khre'u phur bu'i dbal sor bsam// rdo rje gdan du sleb par bsam// zhes bshad pa'i don gsal bar bstan pa srog gi spu gri zhes gter byon 'khrul med du/ mdun du sku'i sprul pa 'chi bdag nag po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis dgra sta dang tsit+ta bsnams pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar bsnyen sgrub kyi bdag mdun gnyis kar sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis kho nar nges shing*/

las sbyor la'ang sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang*/ zhal gsum phyag drug gang rung las/ khyad par zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang man ngag gi don rnams dang ches mthun no// tshul de lta bu 'khrul ba med par dgongs pa'i snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun rat+nas kyang de nyid kyi sku thang phyag bris mar sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis su gnang ba dang*/ bla ma dam pa gung rad tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes rje btsun rat+na'i yang dbu blar gyur pa de nyid kyi thugs dam thang skur yang sde drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzad pa gnyis ka da lta'ang 'dun sa chen po 'dir bzhugs pas mthong ba tsam gyis tshad mar grub bo// de ltar na ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis bshad pa'i rgyud don yal bar dor nas/ dpal 'dzin dang tshe lung sprul sku sogs kyi lung khungs la sems pa ches mi rigs te/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sgron glog nor bu nyi zla la// brten nas mig dang ldan pas lta ba bzhin// de bzhin don chen chos spobs 'od mdzad pa// thub la brten nas 'di ni rab tu bshad// ces so// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa mdo rgyud dpang du bzhag pa'i legs bshad la phyir rgol gyi sun 'byin pa'ang rgyal ba'i bka' las/ phyi rabs pa'i gang zag gis man ngag dang zhal rgyun yin no// zab bo// zhes rlom pa yang rigs pa ma yin te/ de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te// ma lus de nyid mchog tu tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas// de bzhin drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkru+ug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la yang gnod pa byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir| kha cig gis rgyud gzhung nas de ltar bshad kyang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len dang*/ mthong rgyud dang*/ nga rang gi a pha'i dag snang dang*/

a ma'i rmi lam dang*/ nga rang gi shes rab kyis dpyad pas tshul de ltar legs 'dug ces zer ba rnams ni rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'tshed pa'i las yin te/ de nyid las/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces so| |mdo rgyud dri ma med pa'i dgongs pa tshul bzhin du bkral zhing legs bshad kyis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos ni rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshul mtshungs par/ de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan la 'ba' zhig gi// dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa// de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes so// bstan bcos tshul dang mthun mi mthun brtags shing dpyad dgos pa ni lta zhog /rgyal ba'i bka' yang brtags shing dpyad dgos la/ brtags shing ma dpyad par blun dad kyi rjes su 'jug pa ni nam yang mi rigs te/ ji skad du/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis// sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags nas nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang phyi rabs pa kha cig gis/ sman gdong gi rgyud gsum gyi dgongs pa dang da lta'i lag len dang 'gal ba mang rabs shig 'dug kyang re zhig de tsam gyis chog par mngon no// smras pa/ sgra tshad bzo dang gso ba dang*// nang don sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang*// mngon brjod zlos gar tshig rgyan sogs// mkhas pa 'dod pa'i spyod yul min// stong phrag rig pa'i nags khrod du// lung mang nga ro cher sgrog pa'i// legs bshad 'phrog byed dbang po ni// lta ngan wa sogs 'joms zhes gleng*// mkhas pa 'dod pa'i blo can dag /mkhas pa snga mo'i legs bshad la// mkhas par sbyangs shing gzur gnas na// mkhas pa'i grags dkar cis mi 'thob// nga zhes dregs pa'i gti mug blos// nga rgyal cho nge drag po 'debs// nga bdag nga ro sgrog pa dag

/nga yir 'dzin pa las gzhan ci// lung rigs rtogs pa'i blo gros kyi// legs bshad nyi 'od gzi 'bar ba// lugs rtogs 'dod pa'i shes ldan rnams// legs pa'i snang ba rgyas par 'gyur// blo can shes 'dod 'ga' yod na// mkhas pa'i bstan bcos legs 'doms te| |mkhas par 'bad pas sbyangs pas na// blo mtsho ngang gis rgyas 'gyur mod// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skye bo 'gas// ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i blos// mkhris nad can ngor dung la sogs// ser por snang ba de kor mtshar// tshul 'di gzhan blo su+un 'byin pa'i// mngan bgrang ltag chod ma yin yang*// nyi ma'i 'od zer snang ba na// mun pa ngang gis zhi dang mtshungs| |'on kyang lung mang dang mthun pa'i// legs bshad gsong por smras pas na// 'ga' zhig log lta'i mtshang rgol ba'i// nyes brgya mthong ba'i cho nge 'byin// de ko log par rtog pa dag /drag po'i lam du rab dkri ba'i// rnam dkar dge tshogs gang mchis pa// rnam mkhyen thob phyir bsngo bya yi// khe grags rnyed 'tshol gzo bkur dang*// log pa'i lta grub rgyas phyir sogs// ma dag zhing du bsngo bya min// rab 'byams legs bshad 'di yi mthus// rab mang log lta tshar bcad nas// rab dkar dge 'bras mchis so 'tshal// rab 'byams zhing dbang thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa'i legs bshad rgol ngan 'joms pa lung rigs nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'jam dpal sman gdong rgyud gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa la ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i ham stobs kyis gya tshom 'khyog por smra ba'i rgol ba ngan pa 'ga' zhig son pa dag /yang dag pa'i lung rigs kyis tshar gcod pa'i slad du/ mang du thos shing rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la snang ba rgyas pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' gter lung so so'i tshig don gyi cha legs par rtogs shing bskyed rdzogs dang bsnyen sgrub kyi gnas la dbang 'byor ba/

'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las son pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rab myos nag pa zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i stong gnyis pa'i dus dge bar/ lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sar mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go// //swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ maṅga la shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa a laṅkā ra ā gats+tsha//
